exact: perturbation by symbiont of host actin cytoskeleton
related: disruption by symbiont of actin cytoskeleton
modification by symbiont of host actin cytoskeleton

definition: The process in which an organism effects a change that impairs the structure or function of the host actin cytoskeleton. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host actin cytoskeleton
